name: Social media - FB basic
steps: Open Online Store > Themes > Customize for an unpublished copy. Choose the page template, select Add section, and choose Social media - FB basic.
Connect your own content and media before adjusting layout, typography, color, and spacing. Section overrides take priority where the section offers them.
Preview desktop and mobile, test any links or controls, and save. Publish only after reviewing the complete customer journey.

settings.content: Merchant-curated content and native links unless an explicit provider embed is configured. The theme does not fetch social posts, authorize accounts, verify claims or implement feed synchronization.

settings.label: Heading
settings.how: Enter the heading. Replace sample wording with your own content; leave optional fields empty when you do not need them.

settings.label: Body
settings.default: Stay connected with our latest updates, news, and offers on Facebook.
settings.how: Write the body. Keep paragraphs short and preview long text on mobile.

settings.label: Layout style
settings.how: Choose one of the supported options below for layout style. Only the selected option applies; other settings can further customize its appearance.

settings.label: Max width (px)
settings.how: Drag the control to adjust max width (px). Use only the range and increments shown below. Preview at mobile and desktop widths after changing spacing or dimensions.

settings.label: Embed alignment
settings.how: Choose one of the supported options below for embed alignment. Only the selected option applies; other settings can further customize its appearance.

settings.label: Facebook page URL (optional)
settings.info: If left blank, the theme's Integrations → Facebook URL will be used.
settings.how: Select a Shopify destination or paste a valid URL. Use a descriptive button or link label. Empty destinations usually hide the associated action.

settings.label: Embed width (px)
settings.how: Drag the control to adjust embed width (px). Use only the range and increments shown below. Preview at mobile and desktop widths after changing spacing or dimensions.

settings.label: Embed height (px)
settings.how: Drag the control to adjust embed height (px). Use only the range and increments shown below. Preview at mobile and desktop widths after changing spacing or dimensions.

settings.label: Show cover photo
settings.how: Turn on “Show cover photo” to apply that behavior. Turn it off to remove that behavior. Other settings can affect whether the result is visible; check the section preview after changing it.

settings.label: Show friend faces
settings.how: Turn on “Show friend faces” to apply that behavior. Turn it off to remove that behavior. Other settings can affect whether the result is visible; check the section preview after changing it.

settings.label: Show timeline posts
settings.how: Turn on “Show timeline posts” to apply that behavior. Turn it off to remove that behavior. Other settings can affect whether the result is visible; check the section preview after changing it.

settings.label: Lazy-load Facebook embed (HTML loading attribute only)
settings.info: Enable native lazy loading for the Facebook iframe.
settings.how: Turn on “Lazy-load Facebook embed (HTML loading attribute only)” to apply that behavior. Turn it off to remove that behavior. Other settings can affect whether the result is visible; check the section preview after changing it.
